chain.title: A Knife Worth Enchanting
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: a Farmer's Delight diamond knife, a diamond, a gold block and a source block. It is the only cutting-board knife in the ecosystem that never wears out.

chain.title: Bark From A Living Tree
chain.desc: Axe an archwood log on a cutting board. Each of the four Ars Nouveau archwoods gives its own bark, and bark is the reagent that decides what a jam does.

chain.title: Preserving The Bush
chain.desc: Source berries cooked down with sugar in a bottle. The first thing you can do with an Ars Nouveau berry bush other than eat it raw.

chain.title: Berries By The Crate
chain.desc: Nine source berry bushes packed away. It unpacks back to bushes, so it doubles as compact seed storage for a magic berry farm.

chain.title: Crating The Healing Fruit
chain.desc: Ars Nouveau's magic fruits have no storage form. This packs mendosteen pods nine at a time and unpacks them again.

chain.title: Jam That Still Heals
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: a mendosteen pod, cascading bark, a bottle and sugar. Cascading bark keeps the pod's regeneration effect alive through the boil - the wrong bark neutralises it instead.

chain.title: Jam That Does Not Explode
chain.desc: The same recipe with the wrong bark on purpose. Bombegranate normally detonates; neutralised, it is just very good jam.

chain.title: Butchering The Woods
chain.desc: Wilden Hunters drop meat through data/arsdelight/loot_modifiers/scavenge_wilden_hunter_meat.json. The Wilden are Ars Nouveau's only real hostile faction and now they are also livestock.

chain.title: Portioned
chain.desc: Knife the meat on a cutting board. Slices cook faster and feed the skewer and stew recipes.

chain.title: Wilden On A Stick
chain.desc: Skewered wilden meat over a campfire. The first genuinely good food this mod gives you.

chain.title: Grinding The Spikes
chain.desc: Wilden spikes milled into powder. A seasoning that turns a plain skewer into the chimera line's base ingredient.

chain.title: The Sauce Everything Uses
chain.desc: Wilden trimmings reduced in the Cooking Pot. It appears in the pork, steak, mutton and chicken recipes of all five fruit families.

chain.title: After The Chimera
chain.desc: The Wilden Chimera drops meat through data/arsdelight/loot_modifiers/scavenge_chimera_meat.json. Ars Nouveau's boss is now a butchery quest.

chain.title: The Horn Off The Boss
chain.desc: Also a Chimera drop. Every Hornbeer in the mod - five of them, one per fruit - needs one, so the boss is a repeatable ingredient.

chain.title: Boss, Grilled
chain.desc: Chimera meat over heat. The best raw food value in the Ars ecosystem.

chain.title: Glazed And Plated
chain.desc: The Chimera worked into a full block-sized meal that feeds a table rather than a player.

chain.title: Baking With A Trophy
chain.desc: Chimera horn powder folded into dough. Ars Nouveau gives the horn one crafting use; this gives it several.

chain.title: Brewed On A Boss Horn
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: a bastion pod, magebloom, a source berry bush, chimera horn and flourishing bark. Hornbeers are the mod's top drinks and each needs a Chimera kill.

chain.title: Four Barks, One Pot
chain.desc: Blazing, cascading, flourishing and vexing bark reduced together. It needs all four archwood species, which means a complete Ars Nouveau tree farm.

chain.title: The Whole Grove In A Bowl
chain.desc: Arch sauce finished into soup. The completion dish for anyone who planted every archwood.

chain.title: Drinking Something You Should Not
chain.desc: The Unstable Cocktail is the joke at the end of the mod, and it does exactly what its name promises.

chain.title: Storage Made Of Magic Wood
chain.desc: Archwood slab and trapdoor. A Farmer's Delight cabinet in the one wood Farmer's Delight has never supported.

notes: All 79 ids resolve as assets/arsdelight/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys, with zero models_only and zero lang_only entries - an unusually clean jar. Ordering read from data/arsdelight/recipes/*.json: farmersdelight:cutting, farmersdelight:cooking and ars_nouveau:enchanting_apparatus. The mod's real mechanic is the bark pairing: each of the four archwood barks activates or neutralises a different magic fruit's effect when cooked into jam, which is why flourishing/cascading/blazing/vexing bark come before the jams in the chain. Mob drops verified in data/arsdelight/loot_modifiers/: scavenge_wilden_hunter_meat, scavenge_chimera_meat and scavenge_chimera_horn. Chimera horn is required by all six Hornbeers, so the Wilden Chimera boss is a repeatable ingredient rather than a one-off. arsdelight:flashpine_crate packs ars_elemental:flashpine_pod, so the flashpine family only exists when Ars Elemental is also installed. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: ars_nouveau:source_berry_bush, ars_nouveau:mendosteen_pod, ars_nouveau:bastion_pod, ars_nouveau:bombegranate_pod, ars_nouveau:frostaya_pod, ars_nouveau:magebloom, the four ars_nouveau archwood logs, an Enchanting Apparatus, a defeated Wilden Chimera, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:diamond_knife.
